task: Exact interval feasibility of a single hard-path peak under a small-soft component cap and monotone RESET u
original_reset_mask: finite absI>=1e-12 A and nonzero voltage; retain original2799 points in native acquisition order
raw_band_scope: Deterministic sensitivity allowances, not measured noise or replacement scoring gates
Gamma_cap_source: Maximum Gamma of saved refined linear-field seriescycle4 SET trajectory, with its exact frozen gc
Gamma_cap_scope: Predeclared small-soft component hypothesis only, not measured or required bare-device state bound; no tuning after results
numerical_allowance_scope: Fixed inherited numerical sensitivity on soft-current cap, not extra raw-current noise or a global numerical certificate
a_interval_s: L=max(0,((1-delta)*absI-Bcap)/v), U=(1+delta)*absI/v; no subtraction of background as an observed equality
single_peak_necessity: Nonincreasing equilibrium makes a either monotone or first increase then decrease, with platforms allowed. All peak indices including endpoints are permitted
exact_interval_test: For every candidate peak p, prefix admits a nondecreasing sequence and suffix admits a nonincreasing sequence. Use cumulative maxima of L and cumulative feasibility against U; no physical fit or rate selection
witness_rule: If infeasible, find i<j<k with L_i>U_j and L_k>U_j. Rank witnesses by min(L_i,L_k)/U_j, ties by earliest middle native index. Also report maximum absolute gap
high_signal_scope: All three raw currents must exceed10uA for strong classification. Lower-current witnesses retained and downgraded, never deleted from original mask
synthetic_control: Independently enumerate all216 three-node intervals with integer endpoints from0,1,2 and compare interval decision to all integer sequences; include a few longer named monotone/peak/valley/overlap cases
failure_policy: Preserve failed outputs; no cap tuning, looser current bands, new records, or automatic rerun
interpretation: Failure excludes only this monotone-u, bounded-soft, shared-direction-envelope birth/death structure. Passing is an optimistic necessary relaxation with independent per-node interval choices, not proof of a common u trajectory or shared rates
